publication_name: FTSE Russell index pages and methodology documents on LSEG websites
access_description: Public FTSE Russell and LSEG website pages for index methodology. No index level, constituent, or methodology file was downloaded.
auth_requirement: No open index-data licence was found. The website terms say a different policy on a particular site would govern that site.
conditions: Do not collect index levels, constituents, or ground rules automatically. The LSEG website terms prohibit bots and commercial republication. An index-data order form is not held. Index returns stay unavailable.
revision_behaviour: Methodology documents are revised by the index provider. No document was stored, so a revision series was not observed.
unresolved_questions: Whether a page on ftserussell.com carries a different policy from the LSEG website terms. The terms themselves say a different on-site policy would control. No such open licence was found on 23 October 2026.
evidence_note: On 23 October 2026 https://www.ftserussell.com/legal/website-terms-use resolved to the LSEG website terms. Those terms govern other LSEG sites unless a different policy is provided, prohibit automated access and bulk download, and limit copying to personal non-professional use that is not put into a publication. No index file was downloaded.
